title: A request link opens its form even when you are already on Approvals
description: A link that opens a prefilled request — File leave on the home page, Time-in missing on the DTR — only worked when arriving from another page. Followed while already on Approvals, the address changed and the form stayed shut.
items: The form now opens on the right request type wherever the link is followed from
Closing or sending the form clears it from the address, so refreshing the page no longer reopens a form you already dismissed
